run_qr_web_server: run a python module that generates a QR code from a CLI argument and serves it on port 8000
create_qrcode_from_text: create a QR code image from a text string and save it as qrcode.png in the current directory
serve_qrcode_over_http: serve a QR code image and an HTML page over HTTP on port 8000 using the built-in HTTPServer
handle_get_requests: handle GET requests to serve PNG images or an HTML page with a QR code image embedded
generate_minecraft_connect_qr: generate a QR code for Minecraft bot connection info and serve it via a local web server
